A '''turborake''' was a type of rake.<ref name="Secret weapon" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> [[Russell Wake]], a [[Gardener/Legends|gardener]] and caretaker at a [[Unidentified factory (Bellassa)|factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]], held a turborake in his [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. As he did, Wake reflected that since [[Bellassan]]s had begun opposing the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], freedom had become a reality as solid as the turborake he was holding, rather than just a concept to him.<ref name="Secret weapon" />

==Behind the scenes==
A turborake appeared in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'', a [[2007]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the seventh installment in the ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Secret weapon" />
